entries.title: Philemon 1:1
segments: ¶Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our dear helper in the faith,

entries.title: Philemon 1:2
segments: And to Apphia, our sister, and to Archippus, our brother in God's army, and to the church in your house:

entries.title: Philemon 1:3
segments: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:4
segments: I give praise to God at all times and make prayer for you,

entries.title: Philemon 1:5
segments: Hearing of the love and the faith which you have to the Lord Jesus and to all the saints;

entries.title: Philemon 1:6
segments: That the faith which you have in common with them may be working with power, in the knowledge of every good thing in you, for Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:7
segments: For I had great joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been made strong again through you, brother.

entries.title: Philemon 1:8
segments: ¶And so, though I might, in the name of Christ, give you orders to do what is right,

entries.title: Philemon 1:9
segments: Still, because of love, in place of an order, I make a request to you, I, Paul, an old man and now a prisoner of Christ Jesus:

entries.title: Philemon 1:10
segments: My request is for my child Onesimus, the child of my chains,

entries.title: Philemon 1:11
segments: Who in the past was of no profit to you, but now is of profit to you and to me:

entries.title: Philemon 1:12
segments: Whom I have sent back to you, him who is my very heart:

entries.title: Philemon 1:13
segments: Though my desire was to keep him with me, to be my servant in the chains of the good news, in your place:

entries.title: Philemon 1:14
segments: But without your approval I would do nothing; so that your good works might not be forced, but done freely from your heart.

entries.title: Philemon 1:15
segments: For it is possible that for this reason he was parted from you for a time, so that you might have him for ever;

entries.title: Philemon 1:16
segments: No longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother, very dear to me specially, but much more to you, in the flesh as well as in the Lord.

entries.title: Philemon 1:17
segments: If then you take me to be your friend and brother, take him in as myself.

entries.title: Philemon 1:18
segments: If he has done you any wrong or is in debt to you for anything, put it to my account.

entries.title: Philemon 1:19
segments: I, Paul, writing this myself, say, I will make payment to you: and I do not say to you that you are in debt to me even for your life.

entries.title: Philemon 1:20
segments: So brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: give new life to my heart in Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:21
segments: Being certain that you will do my desire, I am writing to you, in the knowledge that you will do even more than I say.

entries.title: Philemon 1:22
segments: And make a room ready for me; for I am hoping that through your prayers I will be given to you.

entries.title: Philemon 1:23
segments: Epaphras, my brother-prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you his love;

entries.title: Philemon 1:24
segments: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my brother-workers.

entries.title: Philemon 1:25
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. So be it.
